title: Notorious Walking Tour: Biggie Smalls' Life & Legacy in Brooklyn
includes: A Walking Tour about Biggie Smalls
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Your tour guide, Marcus, is a lifelong hip-hop fan. The early and mid-90s are still his favorite music era. During the walking tour around Brooklyn, you'll learn about the childhood, life, career, & legacy of Christopher Wallace, aka The Notorious B.I.G. 

You'll visit some of the childhood places that shaped him, art and locations that honor him today, and a few spots you'll recognize from his lyrics. If you love Biggie's music or are a music lover, this tour is for you! 

You'll leave knowing more about "Big Poppa" than you did before. As Biggie said, "If you don't know, now you know!"
